Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau and Longueuil are major centres in their own right, and demand also reaches smaller towns and regions across the province. Cold winters shape the building season across most of Quebec, so renovation, addition and basement work concentrates in the warmer months while planning, quoting and permit work often run through the winter. A homeowner in Quebec hiring a general contractor is usually handing over a whole project, not a single trade. They compare contractors on past projects, reviews and how clearly they communicate, and they often start with a search such as "general contractor Montreal" or "entrepreneur général Québec".
